findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed eggs to be stored above noodles in cooler. Discussed with PIC, eggs were relocated to the bottom shelf in cooler. Ensure proper storage order is bing maintained to be prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed a container of open single service utensils to have a pen resting inside. Discussed with PIC, education on proper storage of single service utensils was provided. Utensils were discarded and pen was moved to another location. Ensure all single service utensils are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer solution to be at 0 ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, bucket was remade and tested at 100 ppm. Ensure sanitizer solution is prepared during all hours of operation and it at the proper concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mops to be resting in bottom of mop bucket. Discussed with PIC, mops were moved and placed in strainer portion of mop bucket. Ensure mops are placed in a position to be able to air dry while preventing any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

(REPEAT) Facility has multiple certified food protection manager licenses on the wall; however, the employee present during the inspection is not a CFPM. Employee had already prepared sushi rice for lunch. There is usually only one employee on duty due to being a small establishment. The employee must be a CFPM then. Ensure the facility operator is aware of this fact. Repeat violation since the pre-opening on 2/19/24.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC. 

Observed only one employee to have read and signed the employee health reporting agreement (see wall behind the cashier station). All food handling employees should read and sign this document. Document has been provided in Chinese and was again provided in Chinese during today’s inspection. The employee on duty is not a CFPM, nor has the document signed. There is a significant language barrier and the documentation/paperwork information appears to be getting lost in translation. The facility would benefit from an educational meeting with a Chinese translator. SCDPH utilizes Dr. Brian Chen from UIS. AS will speak to CK regarding a future educational appointment. Follow-up on 4/5/24 regarding the signed paperwork. Follow-up will not be perform by AS and AS will provide this information to CK (Food Program Supervisor).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

Observed no active sanitization bucket and sushi rice had been prepared. Ensure the sanitization bucket is the first step before food preparation. Ensure tests strip use to verify concentration levels. Bleach: 50-200 ppm. Facility has bleach test strips to check concentration levels. Ensure staff is aware to make a sani bucket before engaging in food behaviors. Discuss further at the follow-up on 4/5/24. See notes in the General Comments regarding an educational inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT) Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. The hand sink in the kitchen needs sealed properly to the wall (caulking is coming away).
2. Self closers are still needed on the bathroom doors. The door has areas visible showing where self closers used to be. Re-install the self closers on both doors.
3. The sushi area in the front has damaged dry wall and needs repaired.

Ensure the above areas are repaired. Ares should be smooth, easily cleanable, non-absorbent, and corrosion-resistant. Correct by the next routine inspection. #1 is a repeat violation since the pre-opening inspection on 2/19/24.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625/3.07 Sec. 3.07. Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.

Observed no allergen training certification for the CFPM’s at the facility. Facility is a Class I (High Risk) facility and needs every certified food protection manager to complete the necessary allergen training certification. Provided educational copy for where/how to obtain the certification. Language barrier persists and an educational inspection with a translator would help explain the needed documentation better. Correct by next routine inspection.
